title: The most expensive pizza ever bought
caption:
On May 22, 2010, a programmer paid 10,000 bitcoin for two pizzas, about $41 at the time.
Today those coins are worth about {price:BTC-USD*10000}.
May 22 is now Bitcoin Pizza Day.
comment: Would you have spent it on pizza? 🍕👇
sources: BTC price: Yahoo Finance, at render time

scenes.say: On May twenty-second, twenty ten, a man paid for two pizzas with bitcoin.
Back then, that was about forty-one dollars.
Today, those coins are worth about {price:BTC-USD*10000}.
May twenty-second is now called Bitcoin Pizza Day.
